9. Dragon Rage (ドラゴンレイジ)
10. Koukou (荒蛟)
11. Wild Horse (ワイルドホース)
12. Mayoiga (マヨヒガ)

111253.description: A romantic comedy about an innocent high school girl named Yatsugi Chihaya who tries to express her love for her math teacher, Yasaka-sensei, by following the teachings of her new-found bible - the EROMANGA. Will Chihaya's feelings ever reach her Sensei? Follow this silly, trashy manga to find out!

title.native: 恋する乙女はエロマンガに夢をみる
title.romaji: Koisuru Otome wa Eromanga ni Yume wo Miru

111254.description:
An office worker named Komari is saved from a monster by a mysterious vampire named Liberta. A vampire yuri action manga from the creator of Tadokoro-san.

Note: Chapter count includes four extra chapters.

111258.description:
Hitori Gotoh just wants to be popular, but the thought of interacting with her classmates makes her fall to pieces. Her solution-become a rock legend so cool that people approach her instead! However, while spending all of middle school in her closet shredding on the guitar may have earned her anonymous internet fame, it did nothing for her social skills. Now a high schooler, Hitori’s feeling ready to shrivel up and die-when she gets a sudden request to fill in for a band! It’s like her wish came true-but does this most anxious of introverts have what it takes to perform in front of a live audience?!

(Source: Yen Press)

111259.description: A lesbian sex worker looks for another job and meets one of her clients in her new place of employment in this heart-pounding love comedy.

111260.description:
Meet your new favorite food critics: a chubby wolf named Mita Jirou and a ripped tiger named Yanagi Kagetora. Kagetora used to eat to live, but all that changed when he met Jirou–who lives to eat! Jirou is more than happy to help his striped feline friend explore the restaurants and delicacies tucked within their city, and he enjoys all their finds with great relish. There’s nothing better than a hot meal to bring two guys together in this deliciously illustrated story of food, fur, and friendship.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: ラーメン狼とカレー虎
彼氏にドン引きされたい源さん

111263.description:
"It's about time I change bodies."

A magician who lived for hundreds of years by taking the body of another was taking a stroll through the forest in search of a new vessel when he found a young boy who was on the verge of dying with a great number of slaughtered monsters before him. With the condition that the magician would protect Erena, the boy's companion, the boy let the magician take body. However, what the magician did not know was that the boy was the swordsman that had been expelled from the hero's party.

title.native: 外道魔術師の憑依譚 ～最強剣士を乗っ取ったら、自分の身体を探すことになった～
title.romaji: Gedou Majutsushi no Hyouitan: Saikyou Kenshi wo Nottottara, Jibun no Shintai wo Sagasu Koto ni Natta

111264.description:
The manga centers on Yamaneko Nokishita, a boy with two childhood friends. The first is an older college girl who has a scar on her forehead that Yamaneko is connected to, and swore that he would "take responsibility forever." The second is a classmate, the diminuitive Mameshiba. The three sometimes hung out together, but when Yamaneko entered his third year of high school, an incident happens when he visits Mameshiba at home...

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: My Wounds Can't Be Erased Even If I Die

title.native: 私の傷は死んでも消さない
title.romaji: Watashi no Kizu wa Shinde mo Kesanai

111265.description:
The duel to determine the ranks amongst students is underway at the Academy. Shortly after transferring schools, Hiroto Shinohara unseats the previous year’s undisputed champion Sarasa Saionji and soon becomes the fastest student in Academy history to rise to Seven Star status—but all of this is a lie?! 

(Source: Yen Press)

111266.description:
Short tales about a girl in a bad mood, and a boy who's nice to her.

Note: The manga got licensed by publishing editorial Kadokawa on February 14, 2022. Its volume got published on March 10, 2022.

title.native: ご機嫌ナナメの吉岡さん
仮免サンタのサンディさん
豊作でござる! メジロ殿

111269.description:
The story is set in the 1990s, and follows an ordinary middle school boy named Yasutaka Etou, who plays games and is bad with girls. One day his female classmate Kaori Kashiwame consults him out of the blue about Neo Geo and SNK games because, as it turns out, the person she has an unrequited crush on is a fan.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: レバガチャアーカイブ

111270.description:
Towa always had the gift of sensing danger. One day, she gets a bad premonition about a boy. She, along with her friend Ririko, tries hard to prevent it from happening. What will happen next?

Prequel to ReRe Hello, featured in volume 3.

synonyms: Oshimen Idol to Maji Love Sex Hatsutaiken

title.native: 推しメンアイドル♀と マジLoveセックス初体験
title.romaji: Oshimen Idol ♀ to Maji Love Sex Hatsutaiken

111273.description:
With the help of a friendly ghost, Masaki, Ono-sensei can examine his young patient's teeth without much fuss. It seems that only Ono-sensei and children can see Masaki. He brings a calming presence, which is convenient for children at the dentist and for Ono-sensei as well. But is he really a ghost? He doesn't remember much about his past but for some reason, he's very attached to Ono-sensei. So much so that Masaki hangs out around the office and even walks Ono-sensei home. Once they reach the entrance to Ono-sensei's apartment however, Masaki is asked to stay out. Ono-sensei doesn't want Masaki to know that something else haunts him behind closed doors.

(Source: June)

title.english: I want to feel you because I like you.

111275.description:
The story is set in a near-future Earth, in the aftermath of a major disaster that shifts the planet's polar axis 90 degrees, situating the poles along the equatorial line and killing everyone on Earth. A moon-based colony avoids the disaster, and begins recolonizing the depopulated Earth by establishing seven cities in strategic locations. However, to ensure the loyalty of the Earth colony, the moon establishes an orbital defense system that destroys anything that flies 500 meters in the air. When an unknown virus kills everyone on the moon, humanity becomes trapped on Earth, where the political intrigues of the seven cities continue to play out.

(Source: Anime News Network)

111276.description:
Seiya is a nightclub host who is secretly raising his late sister's little boy Tenma as his own. Cute and angelic, Tenma is the only love and comfort in Seiya's life. Late one night, a drunk man suddenly kisses Seiya in the elevator of his upscale apartment building, and the dangerous man turns out to live next door...!! A parenting love story about a suspiciously handsome author and a host who isn't interested in love!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Host with a Little Boy and His Dangerous Neighbor
title.native: 子持ちホストの危険な隣人
title.romaji: Komochi Host no Kiken na Rinjin

111278.description: Welcome to the first other world exchange program. An encounter and everyday life with people from other world in a 4.5 tatami mat room.

111279.description: 1998, Hajime Kanou is not on good terms with the school star Eimi Sawawatari, but maybe through the card game Magic: The Gathering they can improve their relationship...?!
synonyms: Destroy all humankind. They can't be regenerated.

title.native: すべての人類を破壊する。それらは再生できない。
title.romaji: Subete no Jinrui wo Hakai suru. Sorera wa Saisei Dekinai.

111280.description:
The visual essay manga will be based on Mizuki's own life. In the series, Mizuki will tell of his peaceful childhood, his experience in World War II, his poor life afterwards​, and his foray into kamishibai picture stories.

(Source: Anime News Network)

111281.description: If you're a man, then you should be able to reach the 100th level. Mao Li, the main character, begins his ridiculous journey in ascending the tower. Will he be able to reach the 100th level?

111283.description:
Full-time housewife Hayame lives a simple and peaceful life. But when her husband suddenly asks for a divorce and her purse is stolen, she is forced to live on the streets without a penny to her name.
In the midst of all this hardship, a rich and mean-spirited high school boy named Issei steps into her life.
Her encounter with this guy soon turns her "peaceful" world upside down...

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title.native: プロミス・シンデレラ

111284.description: Nine years have passed since Douglas and Miriam met. Miriam, who is now a 17-year-old girl, is perhaps falling in love with Douglas. However, Douglas only thinks of Miriam as a child. Miriam goes to a friend's wedding and goes missing. Douglas discovers Miriam, who lost her memory...
synonyms: Stop the time and Wait for me
หยุดเวลาให้หัวใจ

title.native: 時間をとめて待っていて

111285.description: A group of high school girls go on adventures in parallel worlds where they meet different versions of themselves. Follow the daily lives of Asuka Tsuchimiya and the Radio Research Society members that we didn't get to see yet in the anime.

title.native: あかねさす少女４コマぱられる

111286.description:
Collection of short stories by Fujio Ai:

1. Black Hole wa Totsuzen ni
2. Mou Sukoshi de, Itsuka Eien
3. Kimi no Mizuiro
4. Gokujou Beef Curry, Himitsu Iri
5. Eikyuu Red Carpet

(Source: MangaUpdates.com)
synonyms: The Finest Beef Curry with a Secret

title.native: 極上ビーフカレー、秘密入り

111287.description:
When Ye Mo woke up, he found that everything around him seemed to be changed - The beautiful master disappeared; he became the abandoned oneby the family; even more, he became the object of being humiliated by a woman standing on the podiumwith his love letter. But these werenot important at all. The most important thing was that he remembered another terrible thing that didn't belong to him...

(Source: WebNovel)

111288.description: Man and women who doesn't know each other on an uninhabited island, they're free to have erotic situations! romance! survival! Search for your fated lover... now, disembarking!

title.native: 恋活マッチングアイランド

111291.description: Many years ago a man in a turtleneck appeared from a different world, With his cheat abilities and high intellect he cooperated with the dwarves to make the device that changed the world, The "Smartphone". Years later, The world was taken by the magic of social media, And encouraged by his companions, The holy knight Folg has decided to make an account. But with the internet filled with trolls, how will it go for the noob holy knight?

title.native: 異世界最強の聖騎士は情弱すぎて今日もネット炎上してる ～FF外から失礼します～
title.romaji: Isekai Saikyou no Seikishi wa Joujakusugite Kyou mo Net Enjoushiteru: FF Gai Kara Shitsureishimasu

111293.description:
Mana, an office lady in her 30's, was doing well both at work and in love. She was about to get married to her boyfriend, whom she was living with, but he cheated on her and they broke up. Wanting to change the things that just didn't go well no matter how hard she tried, she moved into a share house, but the inhabitants were people there who were not particularly easy to deal with...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 恋にならないシェアハウス

111294.description:
The story of a hero who has fallen into the darkness, Kakine Teitoku is now revealed.

Academy City gathers the best of science and technology and promotes development of esper abilities.

Among them, Kakine Teitoku, the second-ranked of the seven Level 5 espers with incredible power, encounters a young girl named Yuzuriha Ringo. His objective is to obtain data on the first-ranked Accelerator's thought patterns from Ringo, a test subject in the Dark May Project.

However, elements of the Dark Side of Academy City, such as DA, Kuroyoru Umidori, and the Kihara Family, are also targeting the girl's power?!

title.native: とある科学の未元物質

111295.description:
An OL brought home a kitten one day, but it turned into a beautiful black-haired girl in a sailor uniform? And she's a vampire too?!

(Source: Amazon)
synonyms: Story about OL-san Picking up a Cat
OL-san ga Neko o Hirou Hanashi

title.romaji: OL-san ga Neko wo Hirou Hanashi

111296.description: The Demon King's daughter fell in love with the hero's son!?

111297.description: Makoto is in love with his childhood friend Ai. However, every night he is plagued with a strange dream where there is a station he does not know, and he cannot sleep because of it. The curtain to a chilling suspense story of love and survival opens.

111298.description: This is a story about a murdered lady, who then time travels and is reborn as the second daughter in a wealthy household. She was often bullied in her own household. After time travelling, she acts all frail and weak in the situations she encounter, while intelligently overcoming crisis after crisis. Even without a royal background, she is slowly but surely climbing to the top!
synonyms: It's Too Hard to Chase the Tsundere Prince

title.romaji: Ao Jiao Wangye Tai Nan Zhui

111299.description: Kanmuri Ayako owns a watch workshop where many different people visit her – each with their own unique past, anecdotes and thoughts. A heartwarming, gentle story.

111300.description:
Kiichi is a university student working part-time. It just so happens that he's gay and head over heels for his co-worker, Saijyo-san. Maybe it was the intense stares, his flushed face or something else, but Saijyo-san is quick to realize that Kiichi likes him more than just as a friend or co-worker. Even though he's straight, Saijyo-san is pretty nonchalant about going out with Kiichi. What happens after will shape this couple and make them stronger than ever. No one is perfect neither is anyone's love. Will Kiichi and Saijyo-san find happiness despite this fact?

(Source: June Manga)

111301.description:
Contains 4 short stories:

1. Before Miss Modern
2.The Tale of Sagiso
3. Ranmaru's Heartfelt Poetry
4. Misty Morning in Paris

These short stories also included in Haikara-san ga Tooru bunko and reprint versions.

title.native: はいからさんが通る 番外編

111302.description:
If I want to live, I have to date a man?!

A bad relationship that starts with a car accident!

Two men who can't stand each other enter into a love affair in order not to die.

(Source: Comica, translated)

111303.description:
One day, Crown Prince Sieg hears the Voices of the Gods out of the blue. Apparently, his fiancée Lieselotte is a “tsun de rais” villainess destined to meet her demise...and her sharp tongue is just a way of covering up her embarrassment. The prince can hardly contain himself after discovering Lieselotte's adorable hidden side. Little does he know, the heavenly beings that bestowed this knowledge unto him are actually high schoolers! Can he use their divine prophecy (let’s play commentary) to save his betrothed and avoid a Bad End?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: The manga was cancelled due to a disagreement between the original writer of the light novel and the editorial department of B's-LOG COMIC that caused the revocation of the adaptation license. This happened due to mismanagement of the manga adaptation and lack of communication with the original author by the editorial department.
synonyms: Endo and Kobayashi's Live Commentary on the Villainess
The Play-By-Play Commentator Endo-kun and Colour Commentator Kobayashi-san's Live Commentary on the Tsundere Villainess Liselotte
นางร้ายสุดซึน ลีเซล็อตเต กับขบวนการพลิกลิขิตสู่ชีวิตแฮปปี้เอนด์

title.english: Endo and Kobayashi Live! The Latest on Tsundere Villainess Lieselotte
title.native: ツンデレ悪役令嬢リーゼロッテと実況の遠藤くんと解説の小林さん
title.romaji: Tsundere Akuyaku Reijou Liselotte to Jikkyou no Endou-kun to Kaisetsu no Kobayashi-san

111304.description:
Meet Riko, a twenty-nine-year-old office worker with an obsession with video games. Her coworkers can't quite figure her out—she never talks about her personal life, she never works overtime, and she never joins them for happy hour. Is she antisocial? Nope, she's rushing home to play video games alone. That is until a stray cat is found in the office parking lot and ends up coming home with her! Having no experience with pets, Riko uses lessons drawn from video games to guide her in cat care, while her cute companion tries to understand her behavior through a cat's worldview.

(Source: Dark Horse)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: A Gamer Living with a Cat
Life With a Cat and Games
เมื่อคุณเกมเมอร์ เผลอใจเป็นทาสแมว

title.native: 猫暮らしのゲーマーさん

111307.description:
Neglected at home, housewife and mother Momoko has taken to online gaming and is getting close to one of her clanmates after an IRL meet up. She knows it's wrong to get this intimate with someone who's not her husband, but he's so cute and energetic, she just can't help herself!

(Source: Fakku)

111309.description:
So-called “high-achiever” Souya Kizeki has an extreme tendency to want to take care of others. His lazy classmate, Yuzu Noma, is a precious person to Souya—someone he can look after as much as he likes. Both the caregiver and the care recipient are “happy,” but then an unexpected obstacle gets in the way…!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

111311.description:
A high school girl struggling with self-confidence discovers photography, connecting with the world through her camera lens. This unique slice-of-life manga portrays the interactions between girls through their shared hobby of photography.

(Source: emaqi)

title.native: カメラ、はじめてもいいですか？
title.romaji: Camera, Hajimete mo Ii desu ka?

title.native: 私この度、王国騎士団独身寮の家政婦をすることになりました
title.romaji: Watashi Kono Tabi, Oukoku Kishi Dokushinryou no Kaseifu wo Suru Koto ni Narimashita

111315.description:
Recent grad Wujin has no job, no purpose, no one in his life…till he meets Jin. Suave and sulking, Jin has a tough past but a soft exterior. Now, as next-door neighbors, Wujin can’t hide his feelings but…is Jin just toying with him? In that hot, wet, summer, will love reign?

(Source: Tapas)

111316.description:
Craig has been thinking a lot about death lately. Working thirteen-hour shifts to pay off his father’s insurmountable debt, taking care of his little brother in between, exasperated and ready to collapse, Craig can’t help but wonder: would it be easier to end it all? It was just an ordinary day like this when Craig stumbled onto the scene of a bloody murder. Now Craig is on the run, pursued by a criminal organization’s most lethal member: Dean. In the hunt, however, the two soon find themselves chasing anything but death.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes three extras.

111317.description:
The advent of a great cold wave, devastating damage, and a world reset. After awakening from a 500-year-old artificial hibernation, Taro Maizuru realizes that he has lost everything he ever had, including his beloved family and his fortune. Crawling back from the depths of despair in pursuit of an ideal life and purpose, he leaves the distant land he is in, with his sights set on his homeland, Japan.

(Source: K Manga)

111325.description:
High school student Rena has always been able to see ghosts. She's gotten so used to it by now that it doesn't even bother her anymore. But suddenly, a SecuREIty agent name Mitama appears and vows to protect Rena! This action comedy series is out of this world!

(Source: Manga Plus)

Notes:
- Includes 1 extra chapter.
- Thirteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

111326.description: What happens between the unsociable soba artisan and the beautiful master of sake after they form their relationship...

111327.description:
Kiryuu Yoshitsugu, like the predecessors of his family, serves the Saoinji family as a butler and is the primary ward over the household’s first and only son, Kaede. Yoshitsugu has held feelings for his master ever since they were children, however, his master wanted a prince - someone he could never be. He has resolved to at least act as his master’s knight and keep his feelings a secret while his master goes on to find his ideal. But can Yoshitsugu really keep himself in check when his master comes running back saying that he’s met the prince he’s been looking for?

(Source: Fujoshi Undercover)
synonyms: Goshujinsama wa Ouji ga o Suki

title.native: ご主人様は王子がお好き

111328.description: Living as a lecturer at a university, Sumi Keisuke, finds himself drawn to a college student, Shiromoto Kotarou, who soon becomes his newest muse. Keisuke ends up obsessively desiring the boy, clinging onto him with his all his five senses.

title.native: ファイブ センシーズ

111329.description: The sequel​ for Shitasaki ni Yoake no Aji.

111330.description:
There once lived a young man who had been given many titles throughout his life: [Grandson of the Flame Spear Hero], [Son of the Thunder Spear Hero], [Son of the Saint], [Heir of the Duke], [Childhood Friend of the Crown Prince], [Fiancé of The Third Princess]. Thus was Doyle von Agnis, 15 years old. He was born under the expectation that he would succeed and save the world.

However, an encounter with an adventurer revealed to him a certain fact that shattered the very reason for his existence. Running away from the truth, Doyle began living a life of vice, using his family status to reign over all those under him. Then one day in the haze of a mysterious illness, a sudden revelation makes him face reality.

title.native: 甘く優しい世界で生きるには
title.romaji: Amaku Yasashii Sekai de Ikiru ni wa

111331.description: The sequel to Chimamire Sukeban Chainsaw.

title.native: 血まみれスケバンチェーンソー reflesh

111332.description:
Tatsuru is an omega, but pretends to be a beta at school. He dreams of finding a beta wife to marry and living happily ever after, but things don't quite go according to his plan. One day, he drops his suppressants while at school. As he's panicking, and looking for them, alpha Yuta, who picked them up earlier, arrives to return them. But, while the two of them are alone Tatsuru goes into heat...!!!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: オメガポルノ case.たつる

111333.description: A hot demon appeared in my dream! What's a guy to do?

title.native: 姫様それは聖水ですか？
title.romaji: Hime-sama Sore wa Seisui Desu ka?

111335.description:
Yiyoung is building a startup with his college friends. They get a chance to present their proposal to SJ Corporation, one of the leading companies in the country. But in the meeting room he sees Kang Daehyung, the extremely handsome company big shot that's so very much his type, and Yiyoung's heart starts to race...!

Can pretty-faced Yiyoung win both in love and his career?

(Source: Tappytoon)

111337.description: Daily life through the lenses of a fujoshi little sister and a yumedanshi elder brother.
synonyms: The Little Sister's BL Manga X The Big Brother's Shoujo Manga
น้องสาวพลังวายกับพี่ชายพลังสาว

title.native: BLマンガ脳妹×少女マンガ脳兄
title.romaji: BL Manga no Imouto x Shoujo Manga no Ani

111338.description: Bale Beresford serves as a personal agent to the Pope of the Papal Kingdom of Apostolo. Having finished his previous mission, his next assignment is to monitor and attend to Luna, a potential candidate to become the Holy Maiden. Will he handle this mission the same as the others, or will something in him change?
synonyms: I Want to Pamper the Holy Maiden! But Hero, You're No Good

title.native: 聖女様を甘やかしたい！ただし勇者、お前はダメだ
title.romaji: Seijo-sama wo Amayakashitai! Tadashi Yuusha, Omae wa Dame da

111339.description: Noriyuki Hiro is a young man whose entered the same university as his childhood friend. Wanting to impress her (and hopefully get her to fall in love with him), he decides to join the university's Rugby team, who initially are unimpressed with his soft-looking appearance... until they see just how hard he can tackle an opponent.

111340.description:
Seorim was working at a laboratory as a scientist, but…it turns out he’s not especially good at following directions. After exploding some very expensive equipment, his boss gives him the chance to make amends (read: pay him back) by working as a spy in a competitor’s lab. It’s a dream come true! Professor Gong is renowned as a genius innovator and he’s just hired Seorim to work in his lab. Part of his job is testing new products, but just what he’ll be testing in Professor Gong’s lab may be more surprising than the fact that he was hired at all.

(Source: Lezhin US)

111341.description:
The previous lords have committed as many atrocities as possible to fill their bellies. I, the only daughter of that house, had discovered that my servant and lover was a spy. And as the people wanted, my life ended with my execution.

However, with the memory of getting beheaded intact, I began a new life. I was planning to shoulder the sins of my past life and become a nun, but by some trick of fate, I came to work as a maid for the current lord. Under my former lover, whose name, age and even hair colour were all lies.

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue chapter.

111342.description:
17-year-old Kento Toi awakes one morning to find he's shrunk down to the size of a doll, but his doctor says he's in perfect health... Except for one thing: Kento's love for an older boy at school has made his heart grow bigger, which could be perilous! Now, he's got to either get a boyfriend or get shot down, or the swelling could be his doom! Talk about an awkward first crush! Not to mention, his childhood friend Yuki seems to have something in mind for Kento as well... A thrilling, fantastical love story! This manga also contains the following works: "Happily Ever After, Prince-Style" and "How to Discipline a Bad Boyfriend"

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ティーカップトイボーイ

111343.description:
The Mountain of Life is where humanity and nature gained the strength to thrive from, a mysterious land formation powered with energy to bend the very laws of nature it empowers. A tragic plane accident leads to the death of dozens of families, but eight people survived the accident. When the fateful flight crashed into the mountain, it broke apart chunks of stones that channel a life-giving force in them, bringing eight strangers back to life. When confronted with their aberrational existence, a boy and a girl are forced to make a decision that will affect their lives and that of the other reanimated individuals. Being hunted down by the acolytes of the Grim Reaper, these people live a life beyond their natural time on Earth, but they will see the danger of their unnatural existence.

Deputized as grim reapers with a specific task, the boy and girl are now posessed and on a mission: track down the other survivors and take their Stones of Life. Osamu Tezuka recasts the face of death as two youngsters, and their targets range from radio hosts and race car drivers to businessmen and even one that might challenge them to abandon their job and master in a chase for love. If you're already living on borrowed time, death will find a way to track you down and fix the problem, especially when you're one of the Dust 8.

A short child, Ichitarou, is a bit bullied in his days at school. He crushes on Tomoko, the sweet girl that sits next to him, but he's nicknamed "Stupid Ichi" by everyone, from teachers to the class bully. When Ichi takes a trip and finds a book about hypnotism, he unlocks his innate ability and proceeds to bend the world to his whims. While Ichi is now the one in power, will he use this absurd ability to rule the world... or save it? This short story from Tezuka shows that "Stupid Ichi" might rise to the occasion, despite his short stature.

(Source: DMG)

Note: While the initial story was published as 'Dust 18' by the same author, that version was finished prematurely and much later remade into 'Dust 8'. This version contains significant changes from the original.

111346.description: From the mind of Noboru Miyama comes Godo! An adventure set in a mysterious and weird world with influences from Norse mythology. "Put an end to this cursed world! That is your fate!". An alchemist by the name of Godo whose father was charged with theft must seek revenge for his father and his own freedom as he participates in the fighting festival known as Valhalla.

title.native: 極上CEOに捕獲されました

111348.description:
To his teachers, classmates, and parents, Uemura is a model student. But, that is hardly the truth. Beneath his serious exterior, Uemura loves masturbating more than anything else and spends his day thinking dirty thoughts. His facade as a serious student slips when his playboy underclassman, Matsuoka, catches him at school jacking off to dirty panties. Has Uemura finally found someone who can accept his true self?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes a one-shot and 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 上村くんは真面目ないい子。

111349.description: Meet the adventuring school's highest honour student, Touru. Once he got to study abroad, he had a reunion with his childhood friend Nikka. However, what he thought was a girl as human as he was, she was actually a giant of the ogre lineage! Everything is mega-sized in this city of giants. His childhood friend is 100cm taller than him. Somehow his classmates are only girls. Even though he doesn't mean to, miniskirts flutter all around him. Brandish your sword and sorcery in this school-life harem story!!

title.native: 異種族巨少女セクステット！

111350.description:
Ayano lost both her parents and now lives with her uncle in the countryside, keeping her friendship with Arrow, a small white snake she met when she was younger, a secret. He grew quickly, transforming into a splendid, large white snake.

On the summer she turned 14, she was chosen to dance at the village festival. However, on the day of the festival, a large snake that escaped from the circus appears, causing great confusion in the villagers. Amidst the chaos, Ayano is attacked by a strange man. Then, like a large gust of wind, a witch wielding a broom appears and saves Ayano by a hair's breadth. The witch reveals that she had been staying in the village to study folk customs. The witch introduces herself as Oohara and she invites Ayano to attend her alma mater.

Includes a prologue chapter.

title.native: ぬばたまおろち、しらたまおろち 少女と妖魅の魔女学校
title.romaji: Nubatama Orochi, Shiratama Orochi: Shoujo to Youmi no Majo Gakkou

111352.description:
If you make tiny cuts on the skin and apply ink into that area... it becomes a tattoo - a lasting mark that won't disappear even after the wounds heal. Isn't love similar?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

111353.description: A story of a boy who is offered as a priestess to a bug like goddess.

111354.description: Set between chapters 2 and 3 of the main series, this special one-shot tells a story from Gabimaru's past before he came to the island of death.

title.english: Hell's Paradise: Jigokuraku Special One-Shot Side Story

111355.description:
When I open my eyes, I find myself in an unfamiliar car, in an unfamiliar town, in front of the on-ramp to an unfamiliar highway. Before I can process any of this, I see the fiery explosions of multiple car crashes in the distance, and without thinking, I stomp on the accelerator and race toward the scene. I soon find that I’ve driven straight into hell at full speed with no brakes, just like everyone around me...! In the midst of this insanity, I discover the corpse of a girl, and suddenly I know-I am the brilliant detective. And I must solve the mystery of her death.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Manga adaptation and sequel of the anime ID: Invaded.
synonyms: イド：インヴェイデッド ブレーキ・ブ口ークン

111356.description: Awarded work in the 81st Dengeki Daioh newcomer's contest.

title.native: 表情が一切わからない女の子の漫画
title.romaji: Hyoujou ga Issai Wakaranai Onna no Ko no Manga

111357.description: Iguell is an elite demon in charge of defending the seventh level dungeon of the demon lord's castle. She thought she was due to be promoted to become one of the four Demon Kings, but instead she was re-assigned to the Human Resources department? A new comedy about fantasy HR!

111358.description:
Every young couple has high hopes for their unborn child, and Sara and Kouta Takano are no different. But only days away from giving birth, Sara learns about the tragedy of Malala Yousafzai's attempted assassination at the hands of the Taliban, and her pure and innocent belief in the future is shaken. If such a smart and courageous child can be hurt so badly by the world, how can she keep her own baby safe? With Sara now in a state of shock, will the young couple be able to bridge the widening gap between them, or will it tear their family apart?

The reality of this world, as seen through the eyes of an author that has spent years illustrating women and their lives.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Nominated to the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title.native: かしこくて勇気ある子ども

synonyms: Isekai CEO: Rise to the Top!

title.native: 異世界社長 魔王軍で成り上がる！
title.romaji: Isekai Shachou: Maou Gun de Nariagaru!

111360.description: Joseph lived an ordinary life and it all took a turn when he realized he was being stalked. First, his school, then his locker, his phone and eventually his home- every aspect of his life was infiltrated by his stalker. Joseph is at his wits' end when Glen, a stranger, steps into his life at just the right moment and offers him a helping hand.

111361.description:
Magnus, a wizard who gets ordered around by the hero, is kicked out of the party. Right after that, he receives a book written in the language of the gods detailing all the information he would need to defeat the demon king-the ultimate strategy guide!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: The strongest sorcerer who makes full use of the "strategy guide"

title.english: The Strongest Wizard Making Full Use of the Strategy Guide -No Taking Orders, I’ll Slay the Demon King My Own Way-
title.native: 「攻略本」を駆使する最強の魔法使い ～＜命令させろ＞とは言わせない俺流魔王討伐最善ルート～
title.romaji: "Kouryakubon" wo Kushi Suru Saikyou no Mahoutsukai: <Meirei Sasero> to wa Iwasenai Oreryuu Maou Toubatsu Saizen Route

111363.description:
Chiharu and Maki have worked at the same company together for three years. They were both unceremoniously dumped this spring. As they were drowning their sorrows with sake, they were both summoned to another world. They were given the very simple job of cleansing miasma.

Well, there's no way around it. Thus they begin their quest for alcohol, delicious food, and if possible, a faithful boyfriend.
synonyms: Two Saints Wander off into a Different World

title.native: 聖女二人の異世界ぶらり旅
title.romaji: Seijo Futari no Isekai Burari Tabi

111364.description:
After saying goodbye to his old life and looking for a new start, Isumi moves into a small, low-priced apartment. But the employee was mistaken when he thought he could now lead a quiet life - because the walls are very thin and every morning a lustful moan from the neighboring apartment comes over to him. When one day he meets his noisy neighbor, the encounter becomes unexpectedly intense...

(Source: Egmont Manga, translated)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: ラブオール・アパートメント

111365.description:
Alan is the strongest miner in the world, able to reduce mountains to rubble with simply a swing of his trusty shovel. But when Princess Letitia begs him to escort her on a quest to save her kingdom from an invading demon force, he agrees to leave his solitary mountain abode and venture forth, on one condition: she must help him find a successor to train. In this hilarious fantasy tale for fans of RPGs, evil doesn’t stand a chance against the mighty power of the shovel!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Invincible Shovel "WAVE MOTION SHOVEL BLAST!" (　｀・ω・´)♂〓〓〓〓★(゜Д　゜　;;;).:∴KA-CHOOM

title.native: スコップ無双　「スコップ波動砲！」　(　｀・ω・´)♂〓〓〓〓★(゜Д　゜　;;;).:∴ドゴォォ

111366.description:
Raising a hundred heroes and ending the war with an evil god, Eisen saved the world. Having received a great injury from protecting the heroes, he left for the Other World to recover. In that time, the heroes made use of their abilities to contribute greatly to the development of the world. Longing to meet again with the master they admired, they reported to him of their achievements in detail. Reading their letters, Eisen makes a decision to set out and pay each of them a visit as he travels the country to sightsee.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: The Greatest Prophet who Nurtured 100 Heroes, Even if He Becomes an Adventurer, His Disciples Throughout the World will still Yearn for Him

title.native: 100人の英雄を育てた最強預言者は、冒険者になっても世界中の弟子から慕われてます@comic
title.romaji: 100-nin no Eiyuu wo Sodateta Saikyou Yogensha wa, Boukensha ni Natte mo Sekaijuu no Deshi kara Shitawaretemasu @comic

111367.description:
At first, Mantaro Ohara was just an ordinary salaryman with a slightly bigger appetite. For Mantaro, eating is something to be enjoyed and the idea of food battle does not sound attractive to him. But his meeting in Pork Cutlet store with the professional competitive eater, George Hunter, gradually changed his view and passion towards gourmet competition... And they probably would not let this unexpected "dark horse" escape either.

(Source: Manga.Club)

111368.description: A heartfelt comedy about a man who quits his old company job and starts working part-time at an izakaya while searching for more stable employment, and his meetings with various people there.

111369.description:
Ikeda's manga debut.
In front of a mansion where roses blossom, Tomoko and her brother Kenichiro meet a mysterious girl. She looks interested in them but vanish each time they see her.
synonyms: The Maiden of the Rose Mansion

111370.description: The girl in my class who is always sleeping is like a shark. She has sharp, shark-like eyes, hair like a back fin, and a skirt that is way too long. However, I want to get to know this shark-girl!

title.native: シャークな彼女の領域

111371.description: The story and mythology of the Braves has already ended, and their star-spanning fable begins...

title.native: 覇界王 〜ガオガイガー対ベターマン〜 the COMIC
title.romaji: Hakaiou: GaoGaiGar Tai Betterman the COMIC

111372.description: A short collection of one-shots by Hikari Z Ichihara, serialized in Rakuen Web Zoukan.
synonyms: What's With People Wanting To Touch Other People's Butts

title.native: お尻触りたがる人なんなの

111373.description: As humans and demons continued endless wars, the mixed forces of various races, the anti-human allied special operations unit and the cross company, were developing local battles in a dense jungle. The captain of the third company, Dill, is bringing up children while running on the battlefield. It is a nemesis child to defeat. It was a small little human child.
synonyms: The Wolf Child Sora in the War Zone

title.native: 狼の子ソラは戦場にいる
title.romaji: Ookami no Ko Sora wa Senjou ni iru

111374.description:
Aina Tawara works hard at her job, she's well regarded by her colleagues, and she has a steady boyfriend of six months. But her problem is that she just can't keep her room clean.

On the other hand, there is Fukagawa-san, a man who always has a clean desk, doesn't care what others think, and never works overtime.
He is the complete opposite of Aina, which makes him unappealing to her in every way.
On the one hand, he is annoying, but on the other hand, she is envious of him...

When Aina couldn't get her place tidied up in time, she had to cancel her date with her boyfriend, and it was going to be the worst Christmas ever. When Fukagawa-san saw her depressed, he invited her over to his place…?

This is a story for the messy people.
For those people who can't keep thing tidy at work and at life!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a bonus chapter.
synonyms: She Is Not Good At Cleaning Every Day

title.native: カノジョは今日もかたづかない

111375.description:
Successful, well-liked, and beautiful, twenty-six-year-old working woman Shoko Shoji seems to have it all. But behind her picture-perfect exterior is a secret that haunts her: to her chagrin, Shoko is still a virgin. Tired of making excuses for her total lack of dating experience, she signs up to live in the Love House, an experimental program seeking to test if six young singles can find romance under one shared roof. But will this change of pace be enough to help Shoko ditch her v-card for good, or will the trauma of her first broken heart jinx her forever to a life without love?

(Source: Kodansha)

title.native: すぐヌけるマリアちゃん

111379.description:
In a world overrun by grotesque monsters, a once-in-a-generation maverick runs wild!
Thus begins the story of a boy who becomes a “Rōnin”—a being despised by society—and his quest for freedom and liberation!!

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

title.native: 程谷さんを転がしたい

111381.description:
Chitose Oki has a huge crush on his nextdoor neighbor Tomo, but there's one small problem—his height. Back as kids, when his dream girl said she wouldn't marry him until he grew up, poor Chitose took that quite literally. These days, it's not just height—one embarrassing misunderstanding after another keeps them from seeing eye to eye. The truth is, they're both head over heels for each other, but it's a tall order to confess your feelings to the one you love.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Get Married When You Grow Up!

title.english: You Must Be This Tall to Propose!
title.native: 大きくなったら結婚する！
水島さんと触れ合いたい

111383.description:
Shima has always had a hard time finding a job due to his omega status and constant failures in his interviews, but one day he manages to get into the editorial of his favorite magazine "Potato Life." There he meets Amamiya, a kind and trustworthy superior, who despite being alpha is called "pitiful" for his plump and disheveled appearance, because of this Shima decides to make Amamiya the perfect man so that everyone will notice his charms. This is how they begin their project in which they will get closer and closer.

Note: Includes an extra.
synonyms: Shinnyuu Shain no Omega desu ga, Senpai Alpha Kaizoushimasu!

title.native: 新入社員のΩですが、先輩α改造します！
title.romaji: Shinnyuu Shain no Ω desu ga, Senpai α Kaizoushimasu!

synonyms: In the Field Which Isn't Seen Yet

title.native: まだ見ぬフィールドで

111387.description:
Notes:
- Originally a one-shot published in 2019 Issue 18 of Hana to Yume. It was picked up for continuing serialization 2020-02-24.
- Includes eight extra chapters.
- All chapters outside of the first chapter were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

111388.description:
Cool model Towa is an herbivorous rabbit and clownfish chimera. His partner at his next job is a popular model… However, he’s his natural enemy, a first generation carnivorous lion seed chimera. Since his early childhood, he has never been able to forget Towa’s pheromones, “I’ll feel better after holding you once” he says while approaching him?? Hating his constitution and his heat inducing breeding pheromones, he decided he’d never dapple in romance nor sex, yet his body is unable to resist the pheromones of this first generation beast...!

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

111389.description:
When a city boy, Kinuta Jun, transfers to a school out in the country side, an older girl starts following him around. This is Mizobuchi Chinana-senpai, a self-proclaimed slut who wears a revealing school uniform and doesn't shy away from dirty jokes. However, this appearance is all fake, as her lack of knowledge and experience is plain to see.

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

111390.description:
There are two sides to every coin...light vs. dark, good vs. evil, love vs. hate. Sometimes the line between the two grows thin...and it's so, so easy to cross. So it's no surprise that Fudo Aikawa, A.K.A. Red Gelato of the Gelato Five and hero to all people, just may have happened to fall for the villainess and member of the shadow organization Gekko, Desumi Magahara! But when opposites like these attract, there's more than a few obstacles to their love...! What's a pair like this to do?

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: รักเรานั้นไว้หลังครองโลก

title.native: 恋は世界征服のあとで
title.romaji: Koi wa Sekai Seifuku no Ato de

111391.description:
Teenager Hideki Yuu finally musters up the courage to confess to his crush, Miki, only to have her reject him. Three days later, she becomes an idol...

Fujisawa Toru’s debut manga.

111392.description:
A boy gets into a relationship with his deceased older sister's lover.

Note: Includes the one-shots "Warui Seito (悪い生徒, Bad Student)" and "Taneda-kun to Tsukiaitai (種田くんと付き合いたい, I Want to Go Out With Taneda-kun)", and one extra chapter.
synonyms: 種田くんと付き合いたい
I Want to Go Out With Taneda-kun

111393.description:
Everyone in Class 2-D of Kairei Private Middle School receives an e-mail at the beginning of the school year detailing a "class hierarchy." But the number one ranked Tsubaki Himeyama clears away the unrest this causes with her sunny disposition. Normalcy returns to the class... until Himeyama is found to have killed herself on campus. And once her classmates return from her funeral, they find suicide notes addressed to them on their desks! Will these notes expose the darkness class 2-D conceals?!

(Source: MangaUP!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.english: Suicide Notes Laid on the Table

111394.description:
Relunda has always been treated unfairly, constantly compared to her twin sister, whose personality is bright and beautiful. One day Relunda was thrown away into the forest, abandoned by her parents when her sister was taken over to the Great Temple as a child...
In disappointment, the strongest monster Griffon in the forest and a Sky Horse helped her lonely person...
synonyms: My twin sister was taken as a miko and I was thrown away but I'm probably the miko.

title.native: 双子の姉が神子として引き取られて、私は捨てられたけど多分私が神子である。
title.romaji: Futago no Ane ga Miko Toshite Hikitorarete, Watashi wa Suterareta Kedo Tabun Watashi ga Miko de Aru.

111395.description:
Shishima Sakura, penname Ouga (19) winner of the 2018 Niigata Manga Award & the 96th Tezuka Manga Award for her debut, "I want to date you", bring you a one shot about Laila and Anastasia, who inspired each other through ballet.

(Source: Motokare)

111396.description:
Hina can’t be with the one she loves because he’s her older brother, but she also can’t let go of him. Her friend Hana, who is into the occult, lends her a mysterious crystal that can supposedly let someone switch places with another person for one day. Turns out the crystal’s powers are for real, and Hina ends up switching with Yui, her brother’s girlfriend.
This work was in Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-07.
synonyms: A Childhood Friend and Younger Sister

111397.description:
Sinseong High School in Seosan, a small distance away from Seoul. Ji-Won, who came there as a new student, is in the same dormitory room as the slightly otaku Min-Ji and the young lady Anna. With the three of them together, daily life becomes a series of fun!

A school comedy drawn by an up-and-coming Korea-born writer that reveals the realities of Korean high school girls' lives.

111398.description:
Kakeru Shiratori is brilliant, athletically gifted, and always carries himself with impeccable grace: the very image of perfection. Attending a prestigious and time-honored elite high school, he seems to have it all. Yet he harbors a secret he can share with no one! This is the start of a coming-of-age story in which one young man stakes his very life!!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

111399.description:
After drinking with the members of his college department, Asahi was suddenly invited by Toono Sensei to come to his place.

As they enter his home, Asahi was pushed by Sensei to have sex with Tsukasa, an omega who is currently on heat. Asahi being an Alpha couldn't suppress the urge to hold Tsukasa and Sensei was there filming it all on his tape.

Now he can’t seem to get himself out of this weird situation.

111401.description:
Jan finds himself strangely attracted to the hugo Jamil. Is it true love Jan seeks, or a sense of stability?

(Source: Toomics)

111403.description:
City boy Tsubasa Shiki has just moved from Tokyo out to the sticks in Hokkaido—and right in the middle of winter! Despite being dressed in many, many layers, Tsubasa is quick to find the blistering cold inescapable and unbearable. Stumbling around trying to find his way, Tsubasa makes a beautiful discovery: A Hokkaido Gal, buxom but barely covered in the freezing weather! Minami Fuyuki is a Hokkaido local who takes an immediate interest in Tsubasa, wanting him to tell her all about city life. Tsubasa tries to resist falling for the blonde beauty—after all, he’s supposed to be into prim, proper, raven-haired girls!—but there’s no resisting Minami’s electric and boisterous personality.

But will his strict grandmother also be able to appreciate her charms, or will Tsubasa be forced to part ways with his first Hokkaido friend?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes the original one-shot and 3 extra chapters.
synonyms: สาวแกลเมืองเหนือน่าฮักขนาด
Esa gal de Hokkaido es demasiado linda

title.native: 道産子ギャルはなまらめんこい

111404.description:
A big junior is set on pampering her senior!? An uneven love comedy!

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

title.native: おおきい後輩は好きですか？
title.romaji: Ookii Kouhai wa Suki desu ka?

111405.description:
Yato Tsurumi, a teacher at a preparatory school, has the ability to see the "ghosts of places". The afterimage of his old life with his missing lover, Kako, now stands in place of their house, which was washed away by a flood.

Tsurumi then finds himself in charge of a new student, Ima, who is burdened by her ability to hear the "sounds of the dead".

First published as Ima/Uzu Ko Yuku Hakushoku no Hate (今/渦子 ゆく琥珀色のはて) and later collected as Imakako (いまかこ).
synonyms: 今/渦子 ゆく琥珀色のはて
Ima/Uzu Ko Yuku Hakushoku no Hate

111406.description: About Ayeon, and his path to redemption.

111407.description:
Friend versus friend. Grand Master pitted against noob. Self-confident alpha high schooler meets loner who may or may not be a gaming savant capable of defeating everyone he plays. All this and more comes together on the battlefield of PSI BOND – the hottest online game in the world played by the coolest kids in Korea. High speed connections and high school will never be the same again.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

111408.description: In Jang Lin, the martial arts path cannot be walked for those who cannot awaken the martial spirit. In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. Born in Linshui, Chen Nan was an unparalleled genius with talent and thought he would become a great fighter in the future. However, Chen Nan was struck by lightning rays while practicing his martial arts and obtaining the spirit of divine battle, which was able to settle. To break the ultimate rule of Jang Lin, Qin Nan didn’t know that his fighting spirit possessed a great secret that would slowly discover mystery as the story continued.

111409.description: Cool and sexy hotel concierge X Arrogant and fussy prince... How will things turn out?

111410.description:
Nora didn’t want to die. All she wanted, was to save a cat from drowning. When she drowned instead, she woke up in another world: Catsrule, a world ruled by cats! These aren’t your normal kitties though, they walk on two legs and look like us but we’re their pets! It’s not all milk and catnip however, soon Nora is captured and adopted by a cute cat boy who hates humans named Caesar. Can Nora return to her normal life or will she spend nine lives as a cat’s pet?

(Source: Tapas)

Includes three side stories.

title.native: 救命！这个猫统治的世界
title.romaji: Jiuming! Zhege Mao Tongzhi de Shijie

111411.description:
It's thrilling to torture the bad guys. If you keep torturing them, you'll get more fun. A story in which the herorine Su Lüxia and the supporting female character travel through tens of thousands of small worlds together to show countless bastards and bitches who are overwhelmed in various ways.

(Source: Webnovels)

111412.description:
"Could this all perhaps be Hwayeon's dream? Or did Yeonu create this fantasy world in her head to escape her harsh reality?" Hwayeon Ryu, without knowing the cause, falls into a coma at the age of six. Then after 12 long years of her father, Chung Ryu's persistent attempts, she finally opens her eyes. As she wakens from her prolonged sleep, she realizes she not only has her memories but has the memories of someone else's life, Yeonu Lee. Though startled at first, as time passes, she manages to adjust to her new life. Then one day, in hope to have lunch with her father, she pays a visit to the palace. But she ends up taking the wrong turn and finds herself in front of the notorious beast, crown prince Muyeong... The story unfolds then, when the soft and delicate flower Hwayeon meets the arrogant and fearless beast, Muyeong.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes 32 extra chapters.
synonyms: อสูรขย้ำบุปผา
野獣のような皇太子に愛されすぎてる

111413.description:
Yun-Ho is a vocalist of a rock band with a painful past of losing all of his family in a car accident when he was just a little boy. One day, Yun-Ho went to a gathering to hear that his beloved Gyeong-Hun, who has always consoled him in his dark days, had fallen in love with another man.

Yun-Ho runs out from shock and bumps into a mysterious man, Han-Ul who happens to be a mythical tiger. When they run into each other, Han-Ul senses a sweet scent coming from Yun-Ho, and although Han-Ul has never been interested in humans he finds himself intrigued by Yun-Ho.

(Source: Netcomics)

111414.description:
Living in a small town, C and J who had been separated one day by an unknown person.

After 10 years, they finally met and faced each other...

111415.description:
I moved to a new school to start a new life, but how'd I end up becoming the school top dog's boyfriend?!

(Source: Toomics)

111416.description:
The Great Emperor Xingxiu in the Immortal World, whose name on the earth was Tang Xiu, died in a disaster. After his death, part of his soul comes back to his body on the earth. To his surprise, ten thousand years in the Immortal World is only equivalent to one year on the earth.

(Source: WebNovel)
synonyms: Return of the World of the Celestials

111418.description:
The gangster wants to study hard, too?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

111419.description:
A comedy about a puppy love affair that develops unexpectedly.

(Source: WeComics)

111420.description: He is her younger brother, although the two have no blood relationship but she always considers him to be her biological brother … can only be brother that’s all. of course he doesn’t want to be like that, but he is also afraid that he will create distance with her more and more far away. If their first meeting in life was not like that, would they have another result? The girl he loves is right in front of his eyes but is like a wind and can’t hold … Can only as younger brother? How must he do to let her know that he can also become a guardian for her whole life?
synonyms: 1st Kiss – I Don’t Want To Consider You As Sister Anymore
I Don't Want To Treat You As Sister Anymore

111421.description:
My body was swapped with my dog? How could I solve a series of problems with a dog body?? My favorite girl is waiting for me!!!! And my dog is fucking other dogs with my body!!!!! What should I do……

Includes 11 side stories.

title.native: メニューをどうぞ 〜異世界レストランに転職しました〜
title.romaji: Menu wo Douzo: Isekai Restaurant ni Tenshoku shimashita

111423.description:
Kai who was reincarnated into different world, thrown away by the corrupt church into an isolated Island full of dangerous demons. The key to survive on the island is the Kai's Cheat ability to summon a different world's item that Kai only used in. With this ability Kai build a "Pioneering Village". Kai's survival & the fate of the national life!

It is a different world ability that only you can enter, cute girls and survival life!
synonyms: With Single Palm Founding a Pioneering Village a in Another World - Live With The Married Girls in Uninhabited Island Life
Country Building Story in Another World with the Pioneering Village in His Palm ~Easy Life on the Uninhabited Island with His Ever Increasing Wives~
Foundation of a State in Another World With a Hand-Built Colony Village ~Carefree Life on an Uninhabitated Island With an Increasing Number of Brides~
In the Developing Village in the Palm of His Hand, Another World's Record of the Founding of a Country - Laid-back Desert Island Life with an Increasing Number of Brides

title.romaji: Tenohira Kaitaku Mura de Isekai Kenkokuki: Fueteku Yome-tachi to Nonbiri Mujintou Life

111424.description:
This manga collection of stories about beastly love is from the point of view of the devourers and the devoured. Mermaids bring luck, but drag you into the depths. A woman’s bird-like rescuer expresses his love in a language she doesn’t understand. An extraterrestrial angel with no limbs learns to feel. Enjoy these tales of monstrous and, at times, haunting romance in this beautifully illustrated collection that’s sure to thrill.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Our Torsos Align: Human x Monster Love

title.native: 呑むならお前らとこんな時

111426.description: Aside from the guy’s tastes in bed, Taesik doesn’t know anything else about his current partner. Not his real name, his appearance, or even his voice. How long is that kind of relationship going to last?

111427.description:
A sweet, sentimental tale of young love told in a charming visual style.

This story originally appeared in volume 53 of the Japanese alternative comics anthology AX.
synonyms: Love is the Color of Water

111429.description:
Yuuta has never had a family and lived his whole life in an orphanage, until the moment he suddenly got adopted by the Hiiragi family.
He reluctantly accepts the offer and goes to live with them without knowing what to expect from, all of the sudden, having a big family. Expectations are dashed as he finds out this family's secret...

111430.description:
Mawaru has ultra stage fright, so he never gets chosen to join the circus. But when he applies to a circus expecting to fail, he is hired because of his face alone. Now he's really in trouble! Just having someone watching him can make him fail, so the plan that his circus mates think up to calm him down is... "We'll try to distract you with perverted stuff during your acts!" And from that day forward, during practice and during his performances on stage, Mawaru's circus mates continually attack his ass! Ball balancing, contortions, flopping around in the air... Welcome to a Boy's Love Circus: full of shocks and laughter!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: R18 Nyan Nyan Circus: Acrobatic Mid-Air Dick Play
title.native: R18にゃんにゃん大サーカス★アクロバットな空中チン♂プレイ
title.romaji: R18 Nyan Nyan Dai Sakasu: ★ Acrobat na Kuchu Chin♂ Play

111431.description:
The world is nothing but a series of metamorphoses, from changing who you are internally to be a better person to the actual act of growing from a baby to an adult to the elderly. In the world of Osamu Tezuka, transformations show the darkness of humanity. One machine turns humanity's cast-offs into easily-hunted prey. A dancing farmer is turned into a put-upon vagrant only supported by his cat. A giant oaf turns out to be the sweetest and effeminate best friend you could hope for.

(Source: DMG)

111434.description:
Aeons ago, the elder elemental gods granted civilization to the human race, but the world soon splintered as corruption and greed grew without check. Can the forces holding this world together be balanced against human desires, or is everything ultimately doomed to end in destruction?

(Source: MiHoYo)

Includes the Prologue chapter.

111435.description:
As the saying goes, "power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely," and that also goes without exception to three high school students, who set out on a science field trip and encounter the Euphrates tree, a tree that bores fruit that gives superpowers to anyone that eats from it. With the discovery of their new found supernatural powers, will they be able to control it, or will they themselves be out of control?

(Source: DMP)

111436.description:
Namirou Itsuki, named "Baron" because of his impressive size and his herculean strength, lives an ordinary life with his familial problems. He just proposed to his girlfriend Youko, when she starts having strange dreams. Are they an omen? And what will happen to Youko's brother, who witnessed a UFO's arrival in Australia ?

(Source: BlackBox)

111437.description:
In the 16th Century Holy Roman Empire, witch-hunting is at its height—with any kind of misfortune being attributed to them. As a result, those accused of being witches, regardless of truth or circumstances, are tortured, and executed. It just happens that the naturally people-loving witch, Marie, lives during this time—and she wants to live alongside humans! But she can't let anyone find out she's a witch!

Note: Includes 9 extra chapters.
synonyms: Marie the Witch Isn't a Witch
Majo no Marie wa Majo Janai

title.native: 魔女のマリーは魔女じゃない
title.romaji: Majo no Marie wa Majo ja Nai

111438.description:
Finally, Miriam and Douglas are a couple... sort of. With Douglas' unromantic, awkward ways and his determination not to fall head-over-heels in love with her, Miriam sees no romance in their future.

But enter an assassin bent on killing Douglas for the damage he caused the criminal Cartel in "Jikan wo Tomete," and maybe things will turn out a little more romantic...in a way.

(Source: skynet)

title.native: それなりにロマンチック

111439.description: Imagine a world where the insects of the Earth have decided to revolt and enslave humanity, and shrink them down to a size that would make them seem to be insects to the new Insect overlords. This new race of humanity is called Michroids, and they are trying to find their new role in the world…

111440.description: In the year 5031, the world became a black and white wasteland full of poisonous gas. He remembers his precious memories.

111441.description: A symbolical story about the meeting of two choir boys, without any dialogue.

111442.description:
Middle schooler Ai has felt someone's presence ever since he was a child. When he wanders into a parallel universe, he meets a girl named Suzuro who looks a lot like his mother. When Ai finds out that Suzuro is the true daughter of his parents, and that he is in fact from the parallel universe, and was switched with Suzuro in the womb—what will Ai do!?

The story of a boy and girl bound by a quirk of fate.

(Source: Shinshokan)

111443.description:
Despite being an omega, Souichirou is hardworking and quite efficient at work. He aspires to become a politician. In spite of being rather beautiful he didn't want to fall in love or get married and wants to live his single life to the fullest together with his friends. A major reason for that is him being a severe “neat freak”. But fate had something different in store for him… He ends up meeting his destined partner, a handsome hunk who is a king.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

111444.description: Kosuke has lived to play the ideal self as a father at home and as a manager at work. However, his life changes 180 degrees when he meets his daughter’s friend. In front of her, Kosuke was able to be his real self and his worn-out heart was healed. However, he knows that these are feelings that should never be held. The story of the middle-aged man meeting a young girl, presented to the modern people who suppress themselves in society, begins.
synonyms: One of the Great Secrets of a Femme Fatale
ความลับสาวน้อย

111445.description:
Cecil Alldington regained the memories of her past life when she used magic for the first time at the age of 7. Although previously she had been in the prime of her youth, living as a Japanese high school girl, she ended up dying in a traffic accident. After reincarnating, she is now living in the deranged world of an Otome Game where all the Capture Targets are Yanderes! Moreover, since she is now the Heroine’s love rival, her death flags are everywhere and her most likely cause of death is the Capture Target that is currently her servant! Forced to interact with cute boys that are likely to kill her, how will she survive?

The following is the story of how this cheerful and compassionate girl nonchalantly avoids these death flags.
synonyms: The Result of Being Reincarnated is Having a Master-Servant Relationship with the Yandere Love Interest

title.native: 転生してヤンデレ攻略対象キャラと主従関係になった結果
title.romaji: Tensei Shite Yandere Kouryaku Taishou Chara to Shujyuu Kankei ni natta Kekka

111446.description: The vice president of the concert band club has a kiss stolen from her when she rests. A friend of hers requests the aid of a masked student, Mask de Holmes, to solve the mystery of the kiss thief!
synonyms: Fukumen Tantei Masked Holmes to Kiss Dorobou
The Masked Detective, Masked de Holmes, and the Kiss Thief

title.native: 覆面探偵 マスク・ド・ホームズとキス泥棒
title.romaji: Fukumen Tantei Mask de Holmes to Kiss Dorobou

title.native: なにがニャンでも居候!!

111448.description: During summer break, Juri goes to school to attend to committee meeting and happens to meet her schoolmate Nami. Nami is covered in bandages with a crutch, injuries she says she got from a fall; this meeting leads Juri and Nami to become closer than ever as the once boring summer quickly turns into a fun game with Juri playing as Nami's personal caretaker.

111450.description: A sporty tomboy frequently drops by the residence of Kei–an older guy, and a family/childhood friend–to rest. One day, she discovers his porn stash, and is surprised to find that it’s all about girls just like her.

111452.description:
Your animal girl soulmate is out there somewhere waiting to meet you: don’t delay, call today!

(Source: HMarket)

title.romaji: Kemonokko Tsuushin: Risou no Kemomusume, Anata ni Otodoke

111453.description:
19th century America isn't exactly the best place for a half-Asian child and her alcoholic single father. While the daughter struggles to make sense of the world, her father finds comfort in isolating himself. And of course, they fight. Against each other. With fists.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: 2nd Lezhin Comics World Comic Contest Winner.

111454.description:
Soviet interstellar fleet is heading to a new world for humans to settle. Our protagonist has a goal. He is doing his best to become a part of the ruling class on the yet to be colonised planet while his peers are having fun in the Simulated Reality. But something wrong happens on the way there.

Note: The chapter count includes 2 extra stories.

111455.description: A tale as old as time about a "small fatty" boy named Yuzuru who transforms from an ugly duckling into a magnificent swan. What happens when this once ugly duckling turned prince convinces his love to his ex-elementary school classmate?

111456.description:

111457.description:
An fiction based story involving Yoshiyuki Tomino's trials and tribulations in attempting to create the next generation in Japanese anime. This is the story of the events surrounding the creation of the Mobile Suit Gundam series and its shaky and turbulent foundation. While this story is mainly fictional, the central elements and characters are indeed real which gives some factual basis for the story.

Was first serialized as Gundam Sousei (ガンダム創世), part of the Gundam-san series.
Also includes the side story Tomino Den (トミノ伝) and two extras.

111459.description:
Two big surprises await transfer student Yamada Hajime on his first day at his new school:

1) He's the school's first male student.
2) There's no manga club... The closest thing is the Technology Club, a nest of female nerds! There's President Aika, a cheerful girl who literally wants to be a ninja; first year Natsuki, a tanned kogal with game skills to make pros weep; BL author Sae, a hardcore fujoshi who's long-since abandoned the need for 3D boys; and Risa, the crossplaying prince of the all-girls school. Even their faculty advisor, Kokoro, moonlights as a super popular ero mangaka! The quirky girls of the Technology Club find themselves defenseless against Hajime's eroge-honed silver tongue, but otaku girls are still girls and toying with tender hearts has its consequences.

Can Hajime manage to juggle five girls, or will this club of fujoshi figure they have no use for men after all?

(Source: Fakku!)

title.english: Prince of the Female Otaku Club ☆
title.native: 女子オタサーの王子様☆

111460.description: Do you know the dark dictionary? No one knows when this book has been in the world. However, it is a terrifying book that has long been devastated by human fear. At some point, it will be quietly placed in a secondhand bookstore, in a library, or in a midnight convenience store. And invite what you get into the world of terror.

111461.description:
A crafty young woman gets more than she bargained for when she connives her way onto a sexy reality show!

Down on her luck and pushing 30, Yuuna needs a plan to dig herself out from under her mountain of debt. Fortunately, she knows just the thing: Tamarowa, the famous reality television show where women compete for the right to marry into the riches! She may not be the most well-connected contestant, or the prettiest, or the most provocative, but she's willing to do whatever it takes to thwart the competition and bag her man and his moneybags.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Tamarowa ~The "Marry into Riches" Battle Royale, where women with special circumstances gather around a hunk and aim for his money with their 100%~

title.english: Who Wants to Marry a Billionaire?

111462.description: A short story about a boy, a girl, the moon and love.
synonyms: The Moon Is Beautiful, Isn't It?

111463.description: Tamaki lives his ordinary live as he sees fits until stumbling upon a mirror...

111464.description: An after school romance of two girls.

111465.description: Two sisters share their experiences and thoughts one summer vacation in Matsuyama, Ehime.

title.native: それほど暇ではありません。
title.romaji: Sore hodo Hima de wa Arimasen.

111466.description: The manga was published in Tetsuya Tsutsui's site: pn221.

111467.description:
'Akira, are you not drawing anymore?'

That was what my childhood friend asked me. She who was always shining, a story of youth by Shueisha Bronze Award Rookie Winner that shine so bright that it'll burn the back of your eyelids.

title.native: 彼女はいつも輝いていた

111468.description:
In a city infamously known as the "Demon's Gate," Masato Kawashima lived an ordinary life—until a sudden tragedy changed everything. Now cursed with immortality, he must confront his destiny and uncover the truth behind the demons!

(Source: Emaqi)
synonyms: Kimongai, la ville aux portes des enfers

title.native: 遠藤良子は遠慮がない
title.romaji: Endo Ryoko wa Enryo ga nai

synonyms: The Misadventures of the Small Anime Club

あの子とスマブラしたい

111473.description:
Saki is irritated by the frilly and feminine office suck-up, and decides to take her down a peg by sabotaging her work, but she finds out appearances can be deceiving once Honoka finds out and seeks revenge.

(Source: Fakku!)
synonyms: Be Careful Around The Nice Ones

title.native: ゆるふわ女子に気を付けて
title.romaji: Yurufuwa Joshi ni Ki wo Tsukete

111474.description:
At the age of 14, her first lover was her sister's former best friend, Kyoko. It was a time where Noriko would meet Kyoko after school and be thrilled by the smell of her adult perfume and enchanting eyes, nothing like spending time with her boring classmates. But why did Kyoko and her sister stop being friends in the first place? This is the story of three women and their discovery of what true "love" entails.

Note: The chapter count includes two bonus chapters from the physical release.

111475.description:
As the deadliest assassin in the Seong Empire, Yeseo is stumped by very few jobs that come her way. But when Emperor Ahon hires her to find the spy hiding in his palace, she must also play the part of his new airheaded concubine as a cover. It takes all her patience to keep up her lovey-dovey act with Ahon during the day, and all her smarts to sniff out the enemy at night. If only she could wrap up this job quickly and collect her handsome reward-- but with so many suspicious officials and the tangled web of alliances inside the court, it's hard to tell who the true culprit could be. Can Yeseo catch this mysterious spy before she loses her sanity and blows her own cover?

(Source: Tappytoon)

111476.description:
A site called "Would you like to become a novelist?" otherwise known as “Narima” is taking the world by storm. Rindou Routa is a writer on Narima who receives a merciless review one day from a reader named "AKNY." Wallowing in his misery, he happens across a lost phone in his classroom and sees the letters "AKNY" flash across its screen. Still in shock, Routa's eyes widen even further when the queen of the school, Akaneya Himeko, comes in and declares, "Ah, that’s my cellphone!" WHAAAT?!

Includes 2 bonus chapters.
synonyms: If You Use a Novel Posting Site, the Beautiful Girl In Your Class Might Be a Reader
I Used a Novel Posting Site and the Most Beautiful Girl in My Class Turned out to Be a Reader

title.native: 小説投稿サイトを利用していたら、クラスの美少女が読者だった
title.romaji: Shousetsu Toukou Saito wo Riyou Shite Itara, Class no Bishoujo ga Dokusha datta

111477.description:
Who wouldn't love this beautiful mom? Ryo Ishizuka struggles to hold down a part-time job while also studying for the accountant's exam. He finds emotional comfort in one of his coworkers, Yuzuki Tachibana, a widow with a young child. As his attraction toward her grows, he prepares himself to confess his feelings, but what will her reply be? Is love enough to conquer all? Or will the road to a relationship not be so easy? And what about lullabies and sleepy-time hugs? Get ready to be pampered to your heart's delight by this super-pure rom com, centered around a single mom and a freelancer!

(Source: One Peace Books)
synonyms: I want your mother to be with me!
Kimi no Okaa-san o Boku ni Kudasai!

title.english: I Want Your Mother to be With Me!
title.native: 君のお母さんを僕に下さい！
title.romaji: Kimi no Okaa-san wo Boku ni Kudasai!

111478.description:
By the time he realized it, Wallace, The head librarian of the , had no memory. And what lies inside the forgotten library in the furthest end of the world are only a taciturn maid and that he just can't get through.

And then, one day. He met Lucia, a witch apprentice from the village of the beginning, through a mirror. In order to save the world from the slowly encroaching demon lord. Lucia travels together with the hero who appeared in the village of the beginning. As Wallace is supporting Lucia from the shadow, he comes to realize that his past memory is the key to defeat the demon lord. This is a story of them, a lonely and gentle fantasy story-
synonyms: The Farthest Library in the Mirror
Kagami no Mukou no Saihate Toshokan

title.romaji: Kagami no Mukou no Saihate Toshokan: Kou no Yuusha to Itsuwari no Maou

111479.description:
For centuries the Ougi family has been fighting against the forces of evil under the auspices of their patron deity Karura (the Japanese Buddhist derivation of the Hindu Garuda). But when twins are born in the 38th generation, the hereditary powers are divided between them. Shouko has the spiritual abilities of the "Scroll of Heaven" and Maiko the physical powers of the "Scroll of Earth." Their personalities are just as different, but by joining together they can face any evil.

(Source: Girls' Horror Comics)

111482.description:
Early one morning, Yoojin awakens bleary-eyed to a bright light… Did he fall asleep with the TV on? Surely that isn’t a real-life actor sleeping beside him? No, there’s no mistaking it. The dreamy TV star Ryu Se-ryeon is actually in his bed… and he REEKS of alcohol! How?! When?! WHY?! Perhaps it has something to do with Yoojin’s sister, who just happens to be Se-ryeon’s girlfriend. Sound complicated? You ain’t seen nothin’ yet…

(Source: Lezhin)

111483.description:
Spin off of BL ‘The Voice Next Door’ - After meeting in college, Yoonsung’s sultry voice is what brought us together. Sure, being a long-time couple can get dull, but cheating on me?! It’s over and I’m out, moved to a new apartment. So why is my mortal enemy living downstrairs?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

111484.description:
Who'd have thought the Crown Prince would be determined to marry the first miss of the Hua Family, a woman of "easy virtue" and bad reputation? Once the news got out, it broke the hearts of countless ladies in the capital. What?! This bad woman refuses to become the Princess Consort… Ran away with a man for a jar of good liquor? Miss Hua: I'm just a vulgar girl with some street smart. I'm no match for you! The Crown Prince: I will see to it that of all the people in the world, you are left with me but no one to choose from.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 太子妃なんて絶対にイヤです!

111485.description:
During the Chen dynasty, Consort Jing gave birth to a pair of fraternal twins under the rays of sunlight. The prince was born with a cinnabar mole between his eyebrows, while the princess was born with six fingers. Fortune and misfortune appeared at the same time, causing the twins to experience entirely different fates as they were forced to leave their family. The heavenly tribulation is approaching, will the two twins who were separated from birth ever get to be reunited? What methods would they use to fight against their destinies?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

111486.description:
A 19-year-old girl named Qing Tian was suddenly transported in time to an unknown dynasty. At first, she thought she could slowly enter the battles of the harem, but she’s surprised to find out that she's actually the Queen! How did this messy story come to be??

Note: Includes prologue and five bonus chapters.

111489.description:
The year is 1926 in this retelling of Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Little Mermaid”, and Joseon (present-day Korea), is under colonial Japanese rule. Su-A Heo is a handmaiden who spends her days working and swimming in the sea. Her work is her whole life, until one day, when she discovers a wounded independence fighter named Ui-Hyeon Kang washed up on the shore. She nurses him back to health, only to lose her ability to speak in a botched murder attempt by Ui-Hyeon’s comrade, Hae-Su Song. As she travels to the capital, Gyeongseong (present-day Seoul), to get revenge, she finds herself growing more and more intertwined with a strange, brave new world and the people within it.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

111490.description:
In another world, the skill I was bequeathed was――”Summon Kitchen”? Eh, what the heck is that?!

The Office Lady that got mixed up in a high school girl’s summons to another word―Isarai Shiina.

Unlike the warm welcome given to the high school Saintess, Shiina is forced to live in a corner of the royal palace with her mysterious and newly obtained “Summon Kitchen” skill.

Apparently, using the skill to cook food amasses points, which can then be used to evolve the “kitchen”.

‘With nothing better to do, and things being what they are, I might as well work towards getting my glorious dream kitchen!’ but, despite her enthusiasm, Shiina was told to keep the contents of her skill a secret by her guardian knight, Hurst…
